SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(f.FechaRealizado, '%Y') AS Periodo, 
  COUNT(*) AS Total
FROM sqlflow_coordina f
INNER JOIN med_tecnicadetalle mt ON mt.Cod = f.CodCoordinaReglaMotivo AND mt.Estructural = 1
WHERE f.`Realizado` = 255 AND DATE_FORMAT(f.FechaRealizado, '%Y') > 2004 AND DATE_FORMAT(f.FechaRealizado, '%Y') < 2026

      [[AND (({{sede}} = 'SMI' AND COALESCE(f.Hbritanico, 0) = 0) OR ({{sede}} = 'Britanico' AND f.Hbritanico = 1))]]
      [[AND (({{facturacion}} = 'FNR' AND f.CodDestinoFact = 3) OR ({{facturacion}} = 'Otro' AND COALESCE(f.CodDestinoFact, 0) <> 3))]]
GROUP BY Periodo
ORDER BY Periodo;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN am.StentDroga = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ConDroga,
    SUM(CASE WHEN am.StentDroga = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SinDroga,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN am.StentDroga = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS Porcentaje_ConDroga,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN am.StentDroga = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS Porcentaje_SinDroga,
    COUNT(*) AS Total_Stent
FROM sqlstk_movearticulo s
INNER JOIN stk_articulomarcamodelo am 
    ON am.k_id = s.IdMarcaModelo
WHERE s.CodCoordina > 0 
  AND s.IdGrupo = 1301180734254093
  AND DATE_FORMAT(s.Fecha, '%Y') >= {{Anio}};

SELECT  
  dir_paissubdiv.Descr AS Departamento,
  COUNT(*) AS TotalRegistros
FROM
  flow_coordina f
  INNER JOIN pac_ficha ON f.CodPac = pac_ficha.Cod
  INNER JOIN salud_paciente ON pac_ficha.Cod = salud_paciente.NroHistoria
  INNER JOIN dir_comunica ON salud_paciente.k_id = dir_comunica.IdRegistro
  INNER JOIN dir_comunicadir ON dir_comunicadir.IdComunica = dir_comunica.k_id
  INNER JOIN dir_paislocalidad ON dir_paislocalidad.k_id = dir_comunicadir.IdLocalidad
  INNER JOIN dir_paissubdiv ON dir_paissubdiv.k_id = dir_paislocalidad.IdPaisSubDiv
WHERE
dir_comunicadir.IdLocalidad > 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(f.FechaRealizado, '%Y') > 2004 AND f.CodCoordinaReglaMotivo IN (101, 108, 119, 138, 171, 172, 260, 261, 262, 263, 264, 265, 266, 267, 268, 112, 113, 117, 128)
            [[AND (({{sede}} = 'SMI' AND COALESCE(f.Hbritanico, 0) = 0) OR ({{sede}} = 'Britanico' AND f.Hbritanico = 1))]]
      [[AND (({{facturacion}} = 'FNR' AND f.CodDestinoFact = 3) OR ({{facturacion}} = 'Otro' AND COALESCE(f.CodDestinoFact, 0) <> 3))]]
  
GROUP BY
  dir_paissubdiv.Descr
ORDER BY
  TotalRegistros DESC;
